title: CPython subinterpreters GIL release race condition during daemon thread deallocation
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0011: CPython subinterpreters GIL release race condition during daemon thread deallocation
Repository: `torvalds/linux`
Category: `Concurrency & Lockless Race Conditions`
Target File: `Python/pylifecycle.c`

#### Problem Description
PyEval_SaveThread called during concurrent PyInterpreterState_Delete triggers use-after-free on tstate.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Acquire head_mutex before modifying interpreter list and verify tstate refcount with atomic decrement.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0011.py -q`
expected_invariant: Acquire head_mutex before modifying interpreter list and verify tstate refcount with atomic decrement.
